Global Stress: P-Norm Aggregation for Stress Constraints

Description

This tutorial demonstrates topology optimization with global stress constraints using p-norm aggregation. Instead of constraining stress at every element (thousands of constraints), we aggregate von Mises stresses into a single global measure using the p-norm with p=5. This approach enables efficient gradient-based optimization while controlling peak stresses.

The tutorial optimizes volume fraction minimization subject to a stress threshold, demonstrating stress-driven design for cantilever and Half MBB benchmarks.

Setup

using TopOpt, LinearAlgebra

Define the Problem

E = 1.0 # Young's modulus
v = 0.3 # Poisson's ratio
f = 1.0 # downward force
rmin = 3.0 # filter radius

problems = Any[
    PointLoadCantilever(Val{:Linear}, (60, 20), (1.0, 1.0), E, v, f),
    HalfMBB(Val{:Linear}, (60, 20), (1.0, 1.0), E, v, f),
]
problem_names = ["Cantilever beam", "Half MBB beam"]

i = 1  # Select problem (1 or 2)
println(problem_names[i])
problem = problems[i]

Parameter Settings

V = 0.5 # volume fraction
xmin = 0.001 # minimum density
convcriteria = Nonconvex.KKTCriteria()
penalty = TopOpt.PowerPenalty(1.0)  # start with no penalization

solver = FEASolver(DirectSolver, problem; xmin=xmin, penalty=penalty)

Stress Objective

# von Mises stress function (automatically differentiable via Zygote)
stress = TopOpt.von_mises_stress_function(solver)

filter = if problem isa TopOptProblems.TieBeam
    identity
else
    DensityFilter(solver; rmin=rmin)
end

volfrac = TopOpt.Volume(solver)

x0 = ones(length(solver.vars))
# Set stress threshold as 3× initial maximum stress
threshold = 3 * maximum(stress(filter(PseudoDensities(x0))))

# Minimize volume, constrain aggregated stress
obj = x -> volfrac(filter(PseudoDensities(x)))
constr = x -> norm(stress(filter(PseudoDensities(x))), 5) - threshold

The p-norm with p=5 aggregates element stresses into a global measure: ‖σ‖₅ = (Σ σᵢ⁵)^(1/5). This smooth approximation enables efficient gradient computation while capturing peak stress behavior.

Optimization Setup

N = length(solver.vars)
x0 = fill(0.5, N)

options = MMAOptions(; maxiter=50, tol=Tolerance(; kkt=1e-4), convcriteria)
model = Model(obj)
addvar!(model, zeros(N), ones(N))
add_ineq_constraint!(model, constr)
alg = MMA87()

Run Optimization

r = optimize(model, alg, x0; options=options)
